findings.issue: Relation retry loads a new manifest/network while fetchCohortPair reuses scope-only event cache, combining events from S1 with relations from S2. Persistent retry failures also leave events without a network index and break rendering. Reload the pair against the selected manifest; if events cannot update, retain independent news with relations disabled.

The global manifest advances before replacement events verify. If that reload fails, the subsequent network-only retry uses S2 while retained events are still S1. Keep the manifest associated with the last verified event pair on failed reload.

Unlike the map loader, event and network loaders accept manifest-bound artifacts with missing hashes. The main consumer drops the event manifest before loading; a missing manifest also leaves unverifiable relations enabled. Require declared hashes and disable relations when the manifest is unavailable.

A failed manifest retry falls through its inner catch without checking refreshRequestId. After the user switches scope, the obsolete request replaces the current list with its error card. Recheck the request generation on rejected retries as well as successful ones.

summary: 已修正 4 項缺陷：跨版快取重用、manifest 過早換鎖、缺少 manifest/hash 時接受未驗證產物，以及過期重試覆蓋新 scope，並補齊持續失敗時保留獨立新聞的降級處理。Git Bash 驗證通過：858 項單元測試、型別檢查與建置、10 項 cohort 瀏覽器回歸。needs-human：完整真實資料 Playwright 為 25 通過、8 失敗，其中風險篩選逾時已在原始 head 重現；本次未推送或部署。
